Hostility toward both Roman courts increases warning and supply duties.

Variants.Content: Cavalry movement is limited by forage, rivers and seasons; households cannot lose every good mount indefinitely. Hostility toward both Roman courts makes defined warnings and supply essential.

Forage, rivers and seasons limit Jazygian cavalry. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Hostility toward both Roman courts increases warning and supply duties.

Hostility toward both Roman courts increases warning and supply duties. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Forage, rivers and seasons limit Jazygian cavalry.

Forage, rivers and seasons limit Jazygian cavalry. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Hostility toward both Roman courts increases warning and supply duties.

Hostility toward both Roman courts increases warning and supply duties. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Forage, rivers and seasons limit Jazygian cavalry.
